_comment: Red Pen, single reviewer: Claude proposes, GPT attacks — both through OPENROUTER_API_KEY. Use this when you want a fast, cheap run. Tradeoff: one adversary means one model's blind spots — no decorrelation. Run: `node orchestrate.mjs --task "..." --config agents.redpen.codex.json --rounds 5`. To add a second reviewer, copy the adversary block and point it at a different vendor (e.g. google/gemini-3.5-flash), or use agents.redpen.json.

proposer.system: You are a careful, concrete builder. Produce strong, complete work and improve it honestly when the Red Pen lands a real attack — but do not over-correct for objections in the noise band.
